messages:
incident-bot: Alert: Increased 5xx rate and latency from inference pool in us-west-3a. Threshold crossed (5xx > 3% for 5m). Pager: sara :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Paging: @sara oncall. Incident ticket created: INC-20260301-1123. Severity: S2.

sara: I’m on it. observing spikes in p50/p95 for model-xlarge-v1 serving in us-west-3a.

mike: I can pull ASGs and instance metrics. Quick check: any recent deploys?

eli: No deploys in last 2 hours. Autoscaler logs OK. Seems network/errors, not CPU.

sara: seeing connection resets and some TLS handshake failures in the nginx sidecars. Logs:
```
2026-03-01T11:23:45Z inference-proxy-xx TLS handshake error: read: connection reset by peer
2026-03-01T11:23:46Z model-server-yy  upstream response: 502 Bad Gateway
```

mike: handoff from health-checks: 12/150 pods unhealthy in us-west-3a, p95 latency 1.8s (norm 0.2s). Cross-region traffic to us-west-2 increased by 18% as smart-router tried fallback.

eli: Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase!=Running` shows multiple pods Pending with message `0/6 nodes available: Insufficient ephemerals` — looks like underlying instances are flapping on the AZ network plane.

jordan: Can we steer traffic off the AZ at router layer? We have a routing policy to prefer healthy AZs.

sara: Started temporary steer at 11:28 by policy: weight(us-west-3a)=0.3, weight(us-west-2a)=0.6, weight(us-east-1a)=0.1. Not ideal but reduces client errors.

ops-notice: Notifying CS that some customers in west region may see degraded latency. Template sent to customers with affected model ids.

mike: I'm seeing the cloud provider reporting a zonal instance health event for us-west-3a — "network interface instability". Ops ticket CNA-98765. Typical fix ETA unknown.

eli: Quick mitigation plan: (1) increase cross-region fallback weights, (2) enable model-variant fallback to quantized-smaller variant for latency-sensitive routes, (3) spin up Dedicated workers in us-west-2 for high-commit customers.

sara: Implementing plan. Increasing fallback weight now.

sara: Pushed routing delta: weight(us-west-3a)=0.1, us-west-2a=0.7, us-east-1a=0.2. Observed 5xx drop from 4.8% to 1.1% in 3m. p95 down to 0.6s for routed requests.

jordan: For Dedicated customers, starting reserve nodes in us-west-2 (dedicated pool). Command: `infractl allocate-dedicated --region us-west-2 --pool inference-dedicated-small --count 8`

mike: KVCACHE misses increased when requests were rerouted cross-region; expect a temporary burst in token cost. Monitoring token spend.

eli: Customer-impact note: Partial impact for requests pinned to us-west-3a (legacy pins). We need to run a migration script to unpin low-tier requests.

sara: Ran migration for non-enterprise pins (approx 4% of traffic). Those now respect routing policy.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: 30m since inc open. Consider escalations if drop isn't stable.

mike: Cross-checking DNS path: Our private resolver in us-west-3a shows higher latencies and NXTTL spikes. Could be resolver instability causing connection churn.

eli: Added fallback to global resolver pool for service discovery. Command: `update-resolver --svc inference --fallback global`

sara: After resolver change, edge TLS handshake errors down by ~70%. Coupling that with routing adjustments, overall error rate stable ~0.9%.

jordan: Recommend moving to Postmortem if provider marks as 'zonal incident' and we used cross-region fallback. Assigning postmortem owner: eli.

eli: Taking postmortem. Initial impact: ~12% of requests experienced increased latency >500ms, 2.1% of requests returned 5xx during peak window. Customer visible impact limited to legacy pinned flows.

sara: Handoff to night oncall @jordan. I'm available for follow-up. :thumbsup:

jordan: Acknowledged. I'll watch overnight and coordinate with cloud provider updates. Thanks @sara.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260301-1123 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handed off to jordan. Postmortem assigned to eli.

ops-notice: External customer update will be posted in 30m after consolidation of logs and metrics.

mike: Adding runbook links and logs to ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260301-1123

eli: Quick note for postmortem: include timeline of routing deltas, resolver switch, and dedicated pool activation + token cost delta and KV cache miss rate.

sara: Great job team. Low friction handoff.

jordan: Night-watch started. If provider updates CNA-98765 with ETA, I'll reopen channel. Good job.
